terminals.name: console
terminals.description: Next.js admin console on http://127.0.0.1:47261 (dev admin token: defendsec-local-admin).

terminals.name: apid
terminals.description: Go control plane: HTTPS enroll :47262, mTLS gRPC :47263, admin loopback :47264. Dual-writes to Postgres.

terminals.name: agent
terminals.description: Local Go mTLS agent enrolled against apid so a live host appears in the console.
terminals.command: until curl -skf https://127.0.0.1:47262/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; ./bin/defendsec-agentd --server-http https://127.0.0.1:47262 --server-grpc 127.0.0.1:47263 --tls-server-name localhost --enroll-secret defendsec-dev-enroll --state-dir data/agent-mtls
